newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks soar at close on blue chips.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks soar at close on blue chips.

text.p: Pakistani stocks soared 1.76 percent towards the close on Tuesday mainly on buying of blue-chip PTCL and Hub Power shares and dealers said the index would jump across the 1,600-point barrier soon.

"The index will rise another 30 to 35 points in the next few sessions once it crosses the 1,600-point mark," dealer Usma Shoaib said. "Telecom utility PTCL, Hub Power and a few other blue chips were in demand on foreign and local buying."
The index rose 27.57 points to end at 1,593.30. Losers led gainers 219 to 80. PTCL rose 0.75 rupees to 31.75 and Hub Power 1.0 to 41.90. -- Amir Zia 9221-5685192
